Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5260848. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL5260848. Return rows sorted by molecule_chembl_id.
